ARC READER EMAIL TEMPLATE
=========================

Copy this file and replace every [bracketed] part. ARC readers are
volunteers who read your book before launch and leave honest reviews.
Never pay for reviews, and never require a positive one.

RECRUITMENT EMAIL / POST
------------------------
Subject: Free advance copy of [Book title] — looking for [number] readers

Hi [Name],

I'm looking for [number] ARC (advance reader) readers for [Book title],
a [genre] book about [topic], launching [launch date].

You get a free advance copy. In exchange, I'd appreciate an honest
review (good or bad) around launch day, wherever you like to review:
Amazon, Goodreads, StoryGraph, or your own blog.

There is no obligation to review, and a critical review is perfectly
fine. Interested? Reply to this email and I'll send the copy.

Thanks,
[Author name]
[Author email]
[Website]

WELCOME EMAIL (SENT WITH THE COPY)
----------------------------------
Subject: Your advance copy of [Book title]

Hi [Name],

Thank you for being an ARC reader for [Book title]! [Copy attached / link
to download].

A few things to know:
- The book launches on [launch date].
- If you choose to review, an honest review is what I want — critical
  reviews are fine.
- Suggested places to review: Amazon, Goodreads, StoryGraph, your blog.
- In the United States, reviewers who received a free copy often add:
  "I received a free advance copy of this book from the author. This is
  my honest review." You don't have to, but it's a helpful habit.

Your email address stays private. I won't share it with anyone.

Questions? Reply to this email.

Best,
[Author name]

PRIVACY NOTES
-------------
- Send group emails with BCC so readers don't see each other's addresses.
- Never ask for more than an email address.
- Never pay for reviews or require a positive review.
- Delete the reader list after launch if you no longer need it.
